architecture: The service is a small Express API that exports an app factory. On startup it creates a SQLite database (better-sqlite3) in the path from DB_PATH (default /data/shortener.db) and ensures the schema with a UNIQUE code column. A rate‑limiting middleware (express-rate-limit) limits every client IP (respecting TRUST_PROXY) to 60 requests per minute across all routes. The API has three routes: POST /shorten validates JSON input, generates a random 7‑char base62 code (retrying up to 5 times on collision), stores the mapping, and returns JSON with the code and short URL; GET /:code validates the code pattern, looks up the URL and issues a 302 redirect or a 404 JSON error; GET /healthz returns 200 JSON. The app is built into a Docker image (node:lts‑alpine) that runs as a non‑root user, exposes port 3000, declares a /data volume, and reads env vars PORT, DB_PATH, TRUST_PROXY, BASE_URL. No telemetry, no external calls, only local stdout logging. The repository layout follows the brief (src, test, Dockerfile, etc.).
repo_layout:
project-root/
├─ src/
│  ├─ app.js            # creates Express app, wires middleware & routes
│  ├─ routes.js         # route definitions and handlers
│  ├─ db.js             # SQLite connection & schema init
│  ├─ rateLimiter.js    # rate‑limit middleware factory
│  └─ server.js         # entry point that calls app.listen()
├─ test/
│  └─ api.test.js       # integration tests using node:test & supertest
├─ Dockerfile
├─ .dockerignore
├─ docker-compose.yml
├─ package.json
├─ README.md
├─ LICENSE
└─ .gitignore

modules.name: db
modules.purpose: Initialize and expose a better‑sqlite3 Database instance, create schema, enforce WAL mode, and provide a simple query interface.
modules.contract: Exports a function `initDb(dbPath: string): Database` that returns an opened Database with the schema ensured. Throws on unrecoverable errors. The Database object must have methods `prepare`, `run`, `get`, `all` as per better‑sqlite3. No side effects beyond file creation.

modules.name: rateLimiter
modules.purpose: Create an Express middleware that limits each client IP to 60 requests per minute, returns 429 with JSON error and Retry‑After header.
modules.contract: Exports a function `createLimiter(): RequestHandler` that can be used with `app.use`. The handler respects the `TRUST_PROXY` env var when determining client IP. On limit breach it sends status 429 with body `{error:"rate limit exceeded"}` and appropriate `Retry-After` header.

modules.name: routes
modules.purpose: Define the three API endpoints (POST /shorten, GET /:code, GET /healthz) and their handlers.
modules.contract: Exports a function `register(app: Express): void` that attaches the routes to the given Express app. Handlers must validate input, generate 7‑char base62 codes using crypto, store/retrieve via the db module, and return JSON or redirects as specified. Errors are sent as JSON with appropriate HTTP status.

modules.name: app
modules.purpose: Factory that creates an Express application, applies middleware, and registers routes.
modules.contract: Exports a function `createApp(config: {dbPath?:string, trustProxy?:string}): Express`. The function sets `trust proxy` based on config, installs JSON body parser, the rate‑limiter, and calls `register` from routes. Returns the ready Express instance without calling `listen`.

modules.name: server
modules.purpose: Entry point for the Docker container; reads env vars, creates the app, and starts listening.
modules.contract: When executed (`node src/server.js`) it reads PORT (default 3000), DB_PATH, TRUST_PROXY, creates the app via `createApp`, and calls `app.listen(PORT)`. Logs a one‑line startup message to stdout.

modules.name: apiTests
modules.purpose: Integration test suite covering core behaviour using node:test and supertest.
modules.contract: Exports no symbols; the file is executed by `npm test`. It starts the app with an in‑memory SQLite DB (`:memory:`), runs tests for: successful shorten (code length 7, base62), redirect works, unknown code 404, invalid URL 400, rate‑limit 429 on 61st request within a minute, and healthz 200. All tests must pass.

tasks.title: Implement DB module
tasks.prompt: Create src/db.js implementing initDb(dbPath) that opens a better‑sqlite3 database, sets WAL mode, creates the links table with UNIQUE code, and returns the Database instance. Include error handling for schema creation.
acceptance: The returned Database has a table `links` with columns code (TEXT PRIMARY KEY), url (TEXT NOT NULL), created_at (INTEGER NOT NULL).

tasks.title: Implement rate limiter
tasks.prompt: Create src/rateLimiter.js exporting createLimiter() that uses express-rate-limit to enforce 60 requests per minute per IP, returns JSON error with status 429 and includes Retry-After header. Respect TRUST_PROXY env var when determining IP.
acceptance: createLimiter() returns a function usable as Express middleware.
When more than 60 requests from same IP within a minute are made, the response status is 429 and body contains `{error:"rate limit exceeded"}`.

tasks.title: Implement routes
tasks.prompt: Create src/routes.js exporting register(app). Implement POST /shorten (validate JSON, generate 7‑char base62 code with crypto.randomInt, retry up to 5 times on DB UNIQUE violation, store mapping, return 201 JSON), GET /:code (validate pattern, lookup, 302 redirect or 404 JSON), GET /healthz (200 JSON). Use db module for storage and rateLimiter for middleware where needed.
acceptance: POST /shorten with a valid URL returns 201 and JSON containing a 7‑char base62 code.
GET /<code> for a stored code returns 302 redirect to original URL.

tasks.title: Create app factory
tasks.prompt: Create src/app.js exporting createApp(config). It should set trust proxy based on config.trustProxy, install express.json(), the rate limiter from rateLimiter, and register routes from routes module. Return the Express instance without calling listen.
acceptance: createApp({dbPath: ':memory:'}) returns an Express app that can be used with supertest.
When TRUST_PROXY env var is set, app.get('trust proxy') reflects the value.

tasks.title: Implement server entry point
tasks.prompt: Create src/server.js that reads env vars PORT (default 3000), DB_PATH, TRUST_PROXY, creates the app via createApp, and starts listening. Log "Server listening on PORT" to stdout.
acceptance: Running node src/server.js starts an HTTP server on the specified PORT.

tasks.title: Write integration tests
tasks.prompt: Create test/api.test.js using node:test and supertest. Start the app with an in‑memory DB, run tests for all behaviours listed in the acceptance of T3 and the rate‑limit test (61st request returns 429). Add an npm test script in package.json.
acceptance: npm test runs and all test cases pass.
The rate‑limit test confirms the 61st request within a minute receives 429.

tasks.title: Add Dockerfile and supporting files
tasks.prompt: Create a multi‑stage Dockerfile using node:lts‑alpine, install build dependencies for better‑sqlite3, copy source, run npm ci, create non‑root user, set WORKDIR /app, expose 3000, declare VOLUME /data, and set CMD ["node","src/server.js"]. Also add .dockerignore, docker-compose.yml, README with run instructions, LICENSE (MIT), and .gitignore.
acceptance: docker run -p 3000:3000 -v pipez-data:/data pipez returns 200 on /healthz.

build_command: npm run build || echo 'no build step'
